# FreelanceKit

> FreelanceKit is the all-in-one operating system for freelancers and solopreneurs — projects, invoices, taxes, pipeline, and rates in one connected kit.

FreelanceKit replaces the 5+ disconnected tools freelancers cobble together to run their business. It is a web app (no install required) built specifically for solo freelancers and solopreneurs — not adapted from agency or enterprise software.

## Who It's For

Solo freelancers and solopreneurs: designers, developers, writers, consultants, and creatives who manage client projects, send invoices, and need visibility over their income and cash flow. Not built for agencies or teams.

## What It Does (12 Tools in One Kit)

- **Project Tracker** — Tasks, Gantt chart, milestones, time logs, billing phases, and client collaboration
- **Invoice Builder** — Professional invoices with multi-currency support, aging reports, and PDF export
- **Rate Calculator** — Works backwards from take-home target to minimum hourly floor rate, accounting for taxes, expenses, and slow months
- **Tax Tracker** — Estimates quarterly tax liability from income. Not tax filing — gives you a working number so tax season doesn't sneak up
- **Pipeline Tracker** — Kanban board for prospective clients with weighted revenue forecasting (see the dry month before it hits)
- **Timesheet** — Time logging with a 16-week activity heatmap and utilisation tracking against a weekly target
- **Financial Overview** — 4-tab dashboard: earned income, invoice aging, by-client breakdown, month-over-month trends
- **Client Directory** — Contact management with vCard and CSV import/export
- **Meeting Notes** — Structured notes attached to projects and clients
- **Welcome Packet Generator** — Onboarding documents for new clients
- **Project Brief Builder** — Scoping and brief documents
- **Document Management** — File attachments across projects

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | What's Included |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| Free | $0/month forever | Core business tools, client directory, invoice history (view-only) |
| Pro | $0/month during beta · $9/month after beta | Full suite — all 12 tools, invoice builder, rate calculator, tax tracker, pipeline, timesheet, project collaboration |

No credit card required for either plan. Beta pricing applies to all users until beta ends — notice will be given before any change.

## Key Differentiators

- Every tool a freelancer needs in one kit — not just one piece of the puzzle
- All tools are connected: time logs attach to projects, billing phases link to invoices, pipeline forecasts draw from the same data
- Rate Calculator works backwards from desired take-home income (unique — most tools only track what was earned, not what should be charged)
- Pipeline tracker with weighted revenue forecasting — plan around dry months before they happen
- Free during beta, no credit card, no risk

## Competitive Context

FreelanceKit is positioned as an all-in-one alternative to:
- **FreshBooks / Wave / HoneyBook** (invoicing only — no project tracker, no pipeline, no rate tools)
- **Notion / Trello / Asana** (project management only — no invoicing, no financial tools)
- **Toggl / Harvest** (time tracking only — no invoicing, no pipeline, no overview)
- **Bonsai / AND.CO** (freelance contracts + invoicing — limited project tracking, no forecasting)
- **Spreadsheets** (manual, not connected, breaks under complexity)
